record_title: A generalized Kanter inequality for the modified-Bessel family Phi_nu
provenance: A sharp two-parameter lower bound for the Baricz-Pogany modified-Bessel family Phi_nu, extending the real-variable Kanter inequality from order zero to every nu>=-1/2 by a single-crossing weighted-integral argument.
limitations: The theorem concerns the specific Phi_nu modified-Bessel family. The originality claim is based on targeted literature searches and may miss equivalent Kummer-function or beta-integral formulations. Independent audit has not been performed.
